text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
Truth be told, we on our end have also 
completed preparations for the rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
So that Lady <chrname> may apply herself even 
further, 
it is but a modest token of our devotion, 
but pray accept it as a gift.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Azuma-san's assistance, 
preparations for the next Program 
Rehearsal are well underway!
